import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_57/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_57/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source2_57_0 and Source2_57_1 on movie_id
merged = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="movie_id", how="inner")

# Group by title, aggregate count of ratings as size and average rating as mean
result = merged.groupby("title", as_index=False).agg(
    size=("rating", "count"),
    mean=("rating", "mean")
)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
result["title"] = result["title"].astype(str)
result["size"] = result["size"].astype(int)
result["mean"] = result["mean"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_57/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_57/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_57/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source2_57_0 and Source2_57_1 on movie_id
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='movie_id', right_on='movie_id')

# Group by title and aggregate count of rating as size and average of rating as mean
result = joined.groupby('title', as_index=False).agg(
    size=('rating', 'count'),
    mean=('rating', 'mean')
)

# Write the final output with exact target schema column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_57/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
